answer: A stake-and-attestation registry: each agent identity locks a ferrous deposit and earns endorsements from verified agents before claiming rewards. Like a lotus opening only after sustained conditions are met, a new identity gains weight gradually as it completes verifiable work, so fresh identities cannot instantly outvote honest agents. A gale of sock-puppets with no stake or endorsements is weighted near zero. Attackers must pay a deposit per fake identity and build history for each, while misbehavior slashes the deposit, making large-scale fakery costlier than any reward it could extract.
